attributes.name: English Foxhound
attributes.description: The English Foxhound is a medium-sized hound breed that was historically used for hunting foxes. It is an active and energetic breed that is friendly and even-tempered, and is considered to be a very intelligent and obedient breed. The English Foxhound stands between 21-25 inches at the shoulder and has a short to medium-length coat that can come in a variety of colors.
